evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Stating a completed deliverable as fact supplies information that frames the team's output; no influence attempt on another party is performed.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Citing a measured metric to establish a performance claim — controlling the factual record while the comparative framing ('highest this quarter') builds a logic-based case.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Asserting a causal attribution supplies the interpretive fact itself; no argument structure or appeal to an audience is performed.
